description: This file defines a Java class 'UpdateCashierAllocationCommandHandler' that handles commands to update cashier allocations within the teller organization module of the Fineract project. It implements a command handler interface, processes commands, and delegates the update operation to a service.

classes.name: UpdateCashierAllocationCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles update commands for cashier allocation, implementing command processing logic by delegating to the teller write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JSON command to update cashier allocation by calling the corresponding method in the TellerWritePlatformService.
